name: detectors/json-fallback-malformed
description: A JSON body that does not parse (trailing comma) still gets key/value rewriting through the regex fallback, and the malformation survives byte for byte.

steps.input:
POST /api HTTP/1.1
Host: app.corp.io
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 41

{"password":"hunter2","note":"hi","n":1,}

expect.equals:
POST /api HTTP/1.1
Host: app.target1.example
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 46

{"password":"[PASSWORD_1]","note":"hi","n":1,}
